## Research Overview

Research interests span microbial physiology, metabolism, pathogenesis, and integrative biology, with an emphasis on connecting scientific inquiry to meaningful student participation.

## Current Directions

- Microbiology and genomics-centered scholarship
- Discovery-driven student learning experiences
- Research-informed teaching and mentoring
- Interdisciplinary scientific collaboration, teamwork, and leadership
